subject: general
question: Which of the following countries was the second largest source of Foreign Direct Investment in India in FY 2019-20 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mauritius.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **US replaced Mauritius** as the second-largest source of foreign direct investment (FDI) into India during 2020-21 with inflows of $13.82 billion.
 
• **Singapore** remained the top source of foreign direct investment (FDI) into the country for the third consecutive fiscal at USD 17.41 billion.

Source: Click

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India received a total foreign direct investment (FDI) of USD 60.3 billion from April to December 2021.
 
• This is 10.6% lower compared to the USD 67.5 billion of FDI received in the same period of 2020-21.
 
• Equity inflow through FDI during the April to December period of 2021-22 is $43.1 billion which is 16% lesser than the $51.4 billion received in FY 2020-21.
